;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Insurgency in Jammu and Kashmir]]
** [[Indian Army]] troops kill Riyaz Naikoo, a commander of the [[Hizbul Mujahideen]] [[terrorism in India|terrorist]] group, after launching an offensive that resulted in the death of at least three other militants in [[Kashmir]]'s [[Pulwama district]]. [https://in.reuters.com/article/india-kashmir/indian-troops-kill-maths-teacher-turned-rebel-commander-in-kashmir-idINKBN22I1JD (Reuters)]
*[[Operation Gideon (2020)|Macuto Bay raid]], [[United States–Venezuela relations]]
**[[President of Venezuela|Venezuelan President]] [[Nicolás Maduro]] says that the two captured [[Americans|American]] [[mercenaries]] accused of organizing an armed incursion into [[Venezuela]] will be tried in the country by its civil courts. [[United States Secretary of State]] [[Mike Pompeo]] says the [[Federal government of the United States|U.S. government]] will "use every tool that we have available to try to get them back." [https://www.france24.com/en/20200507-nicolas-maduro-juan-guaido-donald-trump-americans-mercenaries-invasion-luke-denman-airan-berry (France24)]
*[[Iraqi insurgency (2017–present)|Iraqi insurgency]]
**Three [[Katyusha rocket launcher|Katyusha]] rockets, fired from the Bakriya neighborhood, land in the perimeter of [[Baghdad International Airport]] but cause no damage or casualties. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/iraqi-military-rockets-strike-baghdad-airport-70528261 (ABC News)]

;Disasters and accidents
*At least two people are killed and two others seriously injured after a plane carrying vital medical supplies crashes near [[Esquel Airport]] in [[Esquel]], [[Argentina]]. [https://www.mirror.co.uk/news/world-news/breaking-plane-carrying-medical-supplies-21980883 (''Mirror'')]

;Health and environment
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in U.S. immigration detention]]
****The first death from [[COVID-19]] in a [[United States Immigration and Customs Enforcement|U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement]] (ICE) detainee is reported in a 57-year-old [[Death of Carlos Ernesto Escobar Mejía|man]] from [[El Salvador]] who immigrated to the [[United States]] in 1980. [https://www.npr.org/sections/coronavirus-live-updates/2020/05/07/852475822/first-death-of-detainee-in-an-ice-detention-center-from-covid-19 (NPR)] [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/first-coronavirus-death-u-s-immigration-detention-reported-n1201711 (NBC News)]

;Law and crime
*[[Shooting of Ahmaud Arbery]]
**A cellphone video of the shooting of an [[African-American]] man jogging in [[Brunswick, Georgia]], surfaces. The two men who killed him claim that they believed he was a [[burglar]] and then got into a fight with him when he was fatally shot. The case is subsequently taken to a [[grand jury]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/2020/05/05/us/ahmaud-arbery-jogging-georgia-shooting/index.html (CNN)] [https://www.cbsnews.com/news/ahmaud-arbery-black-jogger-georgia-fatal-shooting-video/ (CBS News)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2020 Polish presidential election]]
**The Polish governing coalition announces the presidential election, scheduled for May 10, is postponed due to the [[COVID-19 pandemic in Poland|COVID-19 pandemic]]. The new election date will be announced later. [https://apnews.com/908a36d593e86ae089a2f717371e99c9 (AP)]
* The [[National Assembly for Wales]] is officially renamed to [[Senedd Cymru]] (Welsh Parliament)

;Science and technology
*The [[European Southern Observatory]] announces the discovery of Earth's [[List of nearest black holes|closest-known]] [[black hole]] ([[HR 6819]]).  The invisible object in the [[QV Telescopii]] system has a mass at least four times [[Solar mass|that of our Sun]], and is roughly 1,000 [[light years]] (10 quadrillion km) from Earth in the constellation [[Telescopium]]. [https://www.npr.org/2020/05/06/851246887/scientists-find-nearest-known-black-hole-in-distressingly-fitting-metaphor (NPR)] [https://www.bbc.com/news/science-environment-52560812 (BBC News)]
